$comment: The source of sf-empty-state's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/empty-state (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

kind.summary: The reason, which picks the default icon, tone, title and text: first-use offers a primary «Создать» (id create), error and offline «Повторить» (id retry), offline also retries by itself when the network returns, and processing draws a spinner in the icon's circle for work that finishes without the person, or with value a ring with the percentage.

size.summary: 1/3 is always the inline form; 1/2 inside a table or panel, 2 for a whole page: the icon, title role, text and gaps follow.

icon.summary: The section's icon (the one of its menu entry) for no-data and first-use, inbox without one; for nothing-found by filters pass filter_alt_off. The other reasons keep their own glyph unless this is set.

value.summary: processing only: the share done in per cent, 0 to 100 (clamped, whole). Set, the circle is an sf-progress-ring with the percentage; unset, the spinner turns. The inline form keeps the spinner. Provisional name (C120 (2) names no attribute).

heading-level.summary: The title's outline level; its look follows the size.

layout.summary: inline: one line for a list inside a menu, a dropdown or a search -- a small icon, the words and at most one link action, no heading.

live.summary: auto: nothing-found and error are a polite status, the others say nothing; alert: an error the person caused; off: the host announces it.

expressive.summary: The decorative level (owner decision C91, level 2): one soft circle of the primary colour behind the icon of a whole-page state (size 2) for no-data and nothing-found; a list, a table or a card stays plain. Off by default, a strict state; data-sf-style="expressive" on the root or a container turns it on for every state under it, and data-sf-style="strict" turns it off again.

actions.x-summary: The buttons to draw, each sending action {id}; unset, an error offers «Повторить» (id retry)

action.summary: The person pressed one of the actions (retry for an error or offline without actions of their own, create for first-use); for offline also sent by itself with auto: true when the window's online event says the network is back.

actions.$comment: Plain page buttons drawn before the actions list; they ask through the page's own handlers (§4.5).

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

accessibility.$comment: live auto: nothing-found, error, offline and processing are a polite status, the others say nothing; live alert: role alert (an error the person caused); live off: no role, the host announces. The name is the heading, the kind's words of the language file when unset; it is a real heading at heading-level in the block form, none in the inline form. The spinner of processing has an empty label and is hidden, the status says the heading and the text. With value the ring of processing is a progressbar named by the word processing-share («Готово») with aria-valuenow the share: the status says it with the heading when it appears; a later value moves aria-valuenow only, so the region does not speak again, and the visible percentage is aria-hidden (the ring's own rule). Enter and Space belong to the action buttons (role button), not to the empty state.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-empty-state for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), detail-adds (the new detail holds the old fields), attribute-and-property, host-attribute (no shim), manifest-only (the DOM name does not change), retired (no new name; kept and noted by the component until the date).

rows.note: the DOM name and the detail {id} stay; the manifest declares the verb action
rows.summary: The person pressed one of the actions (retry for an error without actions of its own).

x-summary: What a list, a panel or a page says when it has nothing to show: no data, the first time, nothing found, no access, an error, no connection or work being prepared, with an icon, a real heading, a sentence and actions.
x-renamed: settings.title → heading: "title" is a property of HTMLElement.prototype (§3.1, §16 item 26), alias dated
events.sf-empty-state-action → action (the DOM name without sf-<tag>-)
x-decisions: own-verb-words: action is a verb of the empty state alone (the person pressed one of its buttons; detail.id names which, retry for the default of an error); its word is lang events.action.label. The vocabulary's retry repeats one write with its key, which this is not.
version: 1.0.0 → 1.1.0: title is a dated alias of heading, heading-level is a number, actions is declared; a minor while the alias holds (§4.10).
key-effects: the role is status (a live region) and gives no keys; Enter and Space press the action buttons, which are buttons of their own (sf-button), so the empty state maps only Tab: reach.

a11y-role: status written with when {live: auto, kind: nothing-found | error}; live alert gives role alert, live off and the other kinds no role (otherwise none). The name is the heading, else the kind's words of the language file.
number-type: heading-level is an integer 2..6 (§16 item 29; §7.4.1 a heading takes its level from heading-level).
actions: the list setting the element already had as a property, declared with its entries {id, text, appearance}; the slot actions holds plain page buttons.
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows.
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json plus each kind, the inline form and the actions; probe.json drives the retry button, the live roles, the heading level and the alias.
skeleton: none; the empty state is what shows when data came and was empty; it has no port and no late data of its own (§5.4).
css-variables: six public variables read by its own sheet with the role token as fallback (src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json).

version 1.1.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.
version 1.1.2: the first-paint sheet list names the utility sheets its templates draw with (core.runtime 1.0.7 asks for them before the element draws: the style gate).

version 1.1.4: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.1.5: the no-data wording is a finished sentence (ru «Записей пока нет» / «Они появятся здесь, когда их добавят», en «No records yet» / «They will appear here once added»); the first-paint snapshots carry it. Asked by Larena storage review (2026-10-28).

version 1.1.7 (2026-11-07): the inline link is one size below the line -- 1/2 on a size 1 line, 1/3 on a 1/2 one -- instead of the line's size with compact spacing: density no longer changes a button's height (component.buttons 1.4.0, owner rule C01, docs review R022). On a size 1 line the link is as tall as before (32px desktop, 28px phone); on a 1/2 line it is 24px (was 28px desktop, 24px phone). Settings, values and events unchanged. Also: the size-2 title keeps rung 3 (--sf-text--size-3, --sf-title--height-3) when the heading-4 role moves to the body size in the content heading ladder (tokens.typography 1.2.0, docs review R022); unchanged on the page.

version 1.1.8 (2026-11-08): a patch, nothing drawn differently by this element. Its first-paint sheet list names the kbd sheet (component.kbd 1.1.0, docs review R030): sf-button 1.8.0 draws a shortcut's keys with it, and every component that draws an sf-button asks for it before the first paint. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.1.9: the sf-button and sf-button-icon it draws are asked for their current names (appearance ghost for link, status danger for error; actions block, decisions C13 and C15), so the template uses no dated alias; nothing it draws changes.

version 1.1.10 (2026-11-09): the default (size 1) title reads the heading-4 role, which holds rung 2 since the C21 heading ladder (tokens.typography: heading-5 moved to rung 1); the title stays at rung 2, one above the size-1-2 title and one below size 2, as before the ladder. Settings, values and events unchanged.

version 1.1.11 (2026-11-11, owner decision C44): the size 2 title reads the heading-3 step, whose size is that rung, so it keeps its size in a compact region; nothing else changes. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.2.0 (2026-11-12, owner decisions C91 and C65 round 2, R160): the expressive setting -- one circle of primary tone 50 at 12 (dark 20) centred on the icon, its radius the icon box, straight to nothing, never under the text; only a whole-page state (size 2) of no-data or nothing-found (in a list, a table or a card an empty state is not an event; a status is a colour and an icon). Off by default; the theme's data-sf-style="expressive" turns it on without the setting. Nothing else changes.

version 1.3.0 (2026-11-13, owner decision C120, R208): three reasons. processing -- work that finishes without the person (a transcription, a report): an sf-spinner in the same soft neutral circle at the glyph's size and ink, a polite status, the title «Готовится» and a promise, no action. first-use -- the section's icon in the primary role and a primary «Создать» (id create) unless the host gives actions or the actions slot. offline -- cloud_off in the warning role, «Повторить» (id retry), and action {id: retry, auto: true} sent when the window's online event fires (the host loads; the element makes no request). The icon rule: icon is the section's icon for no-data and first-use (inbox without one); nothing-found search_off (filter_alt_off by filters, passed as icon); error in the error role; lock and cloud_off in the warning role. The glyph of the grey circle is on-surface-variant, set at .sf-featured-icon--neutral (component.featured-icon 1.1.3). The expressive setting of 1.2.0 on the integration is kept apart and merges beside this.

version 1.4.0 (2026-11-13, owner decision C120 (2), #q-percent, gallery #all agreed): processing with a known share. The setting value (number 0..100, nullable; provisional name, the decision names none) turns the spinner into an sf-progress-ring in the same circle: the ring's size step is the featured icon's (1, 2, 3 at 1/2, 1, 2; smart.progress-ring 1.1.0 adds 3, the 56 px circle of a page), its box is the circle's box (the circle drops its padding), the track is the circle's fill and the arc and the percentage the glyph's ink (on-surface-variant on the grey circle), given through the ring's internal roles, no public variable set. The ring is a progressbar named «Готово» (lang processing-share); the visible percentage stays aria-hidden. Value is clamped to 0..100 and rounded to a whole per cent. The inline form keeps the spinner (no circle there). Relation cl-progress-ring (lazy).

actions.description: Set as a property: [{id, text, appearance}], drawn at the component's size; each raises sf-empty-state-action {id}. Slot `actions` takes the host's own buttons instead. Unset: error and offline offer retry, first-use a primary create.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: saving the width on a server

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-empty-state wherever a list, panel or page has nothing to show, choosing the kind for the reason; processing for work that finishes later without the person (minutes), not for a load the person waits for.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not show an empty state while data is still loading; that is the skeleton's
Do not hand-build an empty message with a paragraph
Do not use processing for a wait of seconds; that is sf-skeleton, sf-spinner or a progress bar

accessibility.focus: The block title is a heading at heading-level; the inline form has no heading. With live=auto nothing-found, error, offline and processing are announced politely (role=status), the others are not; live=alert makes it an alert, live=off silent. The icon and the processing spinner are decorative; the processing ring (value set) is a progressbar named «Готово» with the share as its value; the actions are ordinary buttons in the tab order. Inside a listbox or menu, place it outside the list element so it is never an item.
